title: anthyllis vulneraria var. colorata
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria var. colorata, commonly known as kidney vetch, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Fabaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of various urinary issues, such as kidney stones and urinary tract infections, due to its diuretic properties. The therapeutic actions of kidney vetch are attributed to its ability to stimulate the urinary system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of kidney vetch include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
